summary: 1. Sep 12 production narrowly beat target (+0.58%, 23,126 BCM) but ore missed by 8.71%, ending Sep 11's three-day ore-beat run; MTD total gap widened slightly to -6.99% while MTD ore narrowed to +6.97%, and crusher stockpile throughput remains under a third of the linear plan pace (29.79% MTD) after a 7h33m maintenance stop. 2. 2. Survey Day 18 (Sep 12) finalized at trucks 23,126 / survey 27,719, gap +4,593 BCM (+16.57%) — higher than the in-progress reading logged a day earlier and the second consecutive positive daily gap, with the comment field reading "All EXC is inside the survey calculation area" for the first time since early June, which narrowed the cumulative MTD survey-vs-truck gap to -13.29%. 3. 3. Fleet availability eased to 84.67% daily (core fleet 76.86%, down from Sep 11's 78.66%) as EX-102 and DR-140 both recovered same day while EX-327 (support excavator) opened a fresh full-day fault, and Peter's own weekly HOD safety round named four separate missing-barrier findings — Finger 3's uncontained overflow, the Southwest Dump's missing guiding beams, and two locations of unbarricaded parked equipment — as one standards-and-verification gap rather than four unrelated incidents. 4. Confirm the survey boundary correction holds for a third consecutive day before treating it as a genuine change in loading practice rather than a two-day exception inside a longer negative run. 5. Install the Finger 3 catchment berm and the Southwest Dump guiding beams before further tipping on those faces — the HOD round's two highest-consequence findings, both flagged as preventable by a weekly edge-protection checklist that does not yet exist. 6. Still no record of a reply to Abel Pienaar's Sep 12 escalation on the survey dispute, or confirmation the dispatch-admin capture implementation went live as he was told to expect. 7. EX-327 (support excavator) opened its first full day down the same day EX-102 — the fleet's other Support Excavator unit — recovered; worth watching whether this is an isolated fault or a pattern worth its own tracking line. 8. Important References, the CIP folder, and the Notion Task Feedback Log were not checked this pass — those run under the separate full-scope "compile mining operations KB" protocol. ### Wiki compile Updated [[daily-production-report]] (Sep 12 production/MTD/crusher/drilling detail, EX-102 and DR-140 recoveries, EX-327 fresh fault, Day 18 survey finalization), [[fleet-availability-utilization]] (Sep 12 fleet-wide Daily/MTD table, per-unit fault detail, EX-102/DR-140/LT-285 recoveries, EX-327 fresh fault), [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] (Day 18 finalized reading, RESOLVED marker on the in-progress-vs-finalized open question, MTD-vs-target detail), [[safety-inspection-patterns]] (new HOD safety observation round — five ranked findings, root-cause framing, three standards recommendations) — `Last updated` bumped to 2026-09-13 (118th pass) on all four. 9. No content removed or renamed from RAW. ---
